card.name: Noun just before "as" phrases
card.fires_on: The last word of a noun phrase where the next word is likely "as" (as recited, as scheduled, as determined). Seen in patent claims and in missed-dose or patient-selection instructions.

modes.label: Next dose as scheduled
modes.description: The word dose or taken in missed-dose advice, just before "as scheduled" or "at the usual time".
modes.example: skip the dose and take the next<< dose>> as scheduled.

modes.label: Patent claim reference
modes.description: The word method in a dependent claim, just before "as recited in".
modes.example: 2. The<< method>> as recited in 3. The

modes.label: Biomarker selection wording
modes.description: A marker or class noun in patient-selection text, where "as detected by" or similar may follow.
modes.example: based on the presence of positive PD-L1<< expression>> in persistent, recurrent, or metastatic

card.writes: It raises "as" (and Chinese equivalents) and lowers "like" and "如" words, so the next word is more likely "as" than "like".
card.plain: It fires on a noun right before the word "as" is expected, such as "next dose as scheduled".
